name: shopify-multi-store
description: Connect, compare, and safely manage multiple Shopify Admin stores at once from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Query and manage multiple Shopify stores at once.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to multiple Shopify Admin stores with separate credentials. Run cross-store GraphQL queries in parallel, compare store data, and route guarded updates to an explicitly named store.
defaultPrompt: Compare products across my Shopify stores.
Run the same inventory query across several stores.
Run an Admin GraphQL query on a named store.
